verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own docs say it sends outbound webhook notifications, but only for 3D Secure challenges, and transaction adjustments (Reversal/Refund) arrive at a client-side endpoint. The pack never shows a general event-subscription system or how a consumer registers a webhook. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription flow, an event-type catalog, payload/signature verification and retry docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
